Claims next to measurements (randomized session tests on this machine)
  rtk (third-party): lower with it on, 40 sessions on / 40 off, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-27
    Claim         "reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands" (claimed;
                  https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk)
    Weekly limit  -40.0% (95% range -41.7% to -38.3%); -0.013 points of the weekly limit per session
                  (95% range -0.014 to -0.013); lower, estimated from API prices
    Usage         tokens per session -40.0% (95% range -41.6% to -38.3%); lower, measured
    Tests         pass rate -25.0 points (95% range -37.5 to -12.5; 40 and 40 sessions that ran
                  tests), measured
  hook_repeat_read (trove): no clear effect, 40 sessions on / 40 off, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-27
    Claim         none: Trove published no estimate for it before the test (docs/techniques.md)
    Weekly limit  -0.0% (95% range -2.8% to +2.9%); +0.00000 points of the weekly limit per session
                  (95% range -0.00092 to +0.00099); no clear effect, estimated from API prices
    Usage         tokens per session +0.0% (95% range -2.7% to +3.0%); no clear effect, measured
    Tests         pass rate +0.0 points (95% range +0.0 to +0.0; 40 and 40 sessions that ran tests),
                  measured

  Every row is one randomized session test on this machine: each new session was given the tool or
  optimizer, or not, by a hash of its key. Sessions are counted under the arm they were given,
  whether or not it acted.
  Weekly-limit figures are estimates for one account, from this machine's meter readings
  (docs/limit-fit.md). They are not official weights.
  Ranges are 95% bootstrap ranges. "No clear effect" means the range includes no change; that is a
  result, not a gap.
  A tool's claim is quoted from its own documentation and is not checked by Trove. Trove's own claim
  is its shadow estimate, made before the test.
  Tools Trove looked at and did not run, and why:
  https://github.com/usetrove/trove/blob/main/docs/external.md#considered-and-not-run.
  Method:
  https://github.com/usetrove/trove/blob/main/docs/benchmark-methodology.md#11-the-claims-table
